caption: The drawing depicts a single, tall leather boot positioned upright and facing left. The boot is predominantly dark brown with variations in shading indicating wrinkles, folds, and texture of the leather material. The boot has a distinct, thick sole and a pronounced heel, both of which are colored in a darker shade. A loop, likely made of leather or fabric and colored in a medium brown, is visible protruding from the top of the boot on the left side, suggesting it is used for pulling the boot on. The stitching and seams, particularly along the side and around the heel, are subtly indicated with lighter tones. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details present.
title: Child's Boot
